text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There's only one reason you're all gathered here today!
I promise you all that I'm gonna show you a great time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday morning.
By chance, Epiphaneia and I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Logotype, Tosen Jordan, Fenomeno,
and Copano Rickey, all looking like
they'd somehow gotten dragged into something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Did you get yourself into some kind of trouble...?"
As her Trainer, I couldn't help
calling out to her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What a coincidence! Today,
I'm going to thank everyone who helped me out yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
Are you talking about all that stuff I lent you yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
She said she forgot her whole bag at the dorm
and ended up borrowing all sorts of things from everyone, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Writing utensils from Logo, a handkerchief from Rickey, tissues from Fenomeno! And a notebook from Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Helping a student in trouble is only natural!
There is no need for thanks.
Just make sure not to forget next time, and that will be plenty.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, it IS necessary! Because I want to return the favor!
Come on, let's go, let's go right away, right this second!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey! ...You really don't listen, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably has something in mind, but... I'm a little worried.
Excusing myself from the folks who got caught up in this,
I decided to follow along with her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: First, let's take a break here!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I haven't even done anything yet, though!?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I've actually wanted to come here.
I heard it's a cafe renovated from an old traditional house.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
As expected, pillars like these really show their age~.
A one-of-a-kind shape layered over long spans of time—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"So you can preserve them in a way like this, too.
...Whew, this is so calming."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is that so?
Well, as long as you like the logo, that's fine!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Drink your tea and relax!
Then after that, let's go shopping!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! Jordan!
I found a lipstick that would look amazing on you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, your voice is so loud! I can hear you just fine, jeez—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! No way! For real?!
RipMira's #07?!
I haven't seen this anywhere since it blew up!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, check out those cosmic-colored gel nails too!
Those would definitely look amazing on you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~~!?
Gel Phantom's Stardust Blue!?
Why is that hereeee!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh! To think I can see the movie version of 'Howl at the Full Moon!' on the big screen again!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd get to hear that famous line,
'I'm just a peace-loving police officer' in person...!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san absolutely insisted on an indie theater
instead of a multiplex... Ah, so this is why.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Heartfelt gratitude! This officer is moved to tears!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then lastly, let's go check out that street over there!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Water qi has the power of 'purification.'
On top of that, this aquarium in particular
has an impeccably balanced landform!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I just kind of entered on an impulse, but this is a very nice place.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ The healing effect is incredible.
I want to tell Tarumae and the others about it too—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely spot.
Hehe, thank you, Epi!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for today~
Hehe, I must admit I was surprised
when you suddenly called me out, though."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm super satisfied☆
Not just me, but all four of us, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A renovated traditional café, hard-to-find cosmetics,
a mini-theater screening masterpieces,
and a heart-soothing power spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it seemed to kick off in pure chaotic frenzy,
a tailored "return gift" that hit the bullseye
was meticulously prepared for each and every person.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
Told ya I'd show you a good time!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone helped me out yesterday!
Thanks to them, it turned into such a fun day as usual.
So this is my way of sharing the happiness back with you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks again for yesterday!
I'm counting on you from here on out, too!"
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful return gift!
By the way, this wasn't just a coincidence... right?
By the way, this wasn't just a coincidence... right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks again for yesterday!
I'm counting on you from here on out, too!"
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful return gift!
By the way, this wasn't just a coincidence... right?
By the way, this wasn't just a coincidence... right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪
If you had fun too, Trainer, then it's the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmh, look, it's the Hachimii kitchen wagon. ...Epi, thirsty? I'm seriously so happy about getting #07~

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great.
Please count me in too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "I was just thinking about preparing a return gift myself, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aha, then me too!
Epi-san, let's drink something sweet
and boost our overall luck!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Umm—so this is a return gift for the return gift?
Ahaha! Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No, it's entirely a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding!
—Or maybe THAT's a lie too?! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you the answer tomorrow!
Consider this a present to you, Trainer! That way you can spend the whole day looking forward to it, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I mean, look—I promised to make sure everyone has a blast today!
